faq.question: Is NEET compulsory for studying MBBS abroad?
faq.answer: Yes, according to National Medical Commission (NMC) regulations, qualifying NEET-UG is compulsory for all Indian students who wish to pursue MBBS abroad.

faq.question: Are MBBS degrees from abroad recognized in India?
faq.answer: Yes, degrees from NMC-compliant foreign universities that meet the minimum course duration (54 months study + 12 months internship in English medium) are fully valid for taking the NExT/FMGE licensing exam.

faq.question: Can I get education loan for MBBS abroad?
faq.answer: Yes, leading nationalized and private banks in India provide education loans for accredited medical universities abroad.
